hunks.baseline: Ganging up was shameful, ambushes were condemned, and anyone who got so much as dirt on their back became a laughingstock.
hunks.sol: Ganging up on an opponent was shameful. Ambushes were condemned. Anyone who got so much as dirt on their back became a laughingstock.

hunks.baseline: “Throw dirt! Keep throwing it!”
hunks.sol: “Throw dirt! Keep throwing!”

hunks.baseline: It was a cheap, cowardly trick even the Demonic Cultists he had fought like sworn enemies decades ago had never used.
hunks.sol: It was a low, cowardly trick that even the Demonic Cultists he had fought like mortal enemies decades ago had never resorted to.

hunks.baseline: *Is that bastard really a martial artist?*
hunks.sol: *Is that bastard truly a martial artist?*

hunks.baseline: What left him even more speechless was the reaction of those so-called subordinates.
hunks.sol: Even more astonishing was the reaction of his so-called subordinates.

hunks.baseline: “Open the distance! Watch the Sword Energy!”
hunks.sol: “Keep your distance! Watch the Sword Energy!”

hunks.baseline: *Have I ever seen bastards this fit to die?*
hunks.sol: *What a pack of bastards begging to be killed.*

hunks.baseline: This was an insult to martial artists—and an insult to the Head Elder himself, who had given his whole life to the sword.
hunks.sol: This was an insult to martial artists—and to the Head Elder himself, who had devoted his entire life to the sword.

hunks.baseline: He was drawing his sword when it happened.
hunks.sol: He was drawing his sword when—

hunks.baseline: A stern shout burst out half a beat sooner. A young man whose face was swollen as if bees had stung him swept a fierce look around them.
hunks.sol: A stern shout rang out half a beat sooner. A young man whose face was swollen as if he had been stung by bees swept a fierce gaze around him.

hunks.baseline: He looked ridiculous, but he had real mettle. Yes. That was how a martial artist was supposed to act.
hunks.sol: He looked ridiculous, but he had real spirit. Yes. That was how a martial artist ought to act.

hunks.baseline: *At least there’s one decent one here.*
hunks.sol: *At least there’s one decent man among them.*

hunks.baseline: “Think dirt’s going to cut it? Mix in rocks too!”
hunks.sol: “You think dirt’s going to cut it? Mix in rocks too!”

hunks.baseline: In a humiliation he had never felt in his life, he even forgot to swing his sword as a clod of dirt flew at his face.
hunks.sol: Overwhelmed by a humiliation unlike anything he had ever experienced, he even forgot to swing his sword as a clod of dirt flew into his face.

hunks.baseline: He could say this without hesitation: looking back on eighty years, he had never taken a hit so humiliating, or so completely undefended.
hunks.sol: He could say this with absolute certainty: in all his eighty years, he had never taken an attack so humiliatingly or with his guard so completely down.

hunks.baseline: Through the dirt pattering down, he spotted a chunk of stone mixed in nice and solid.
hunks.sol: As the dirt pattered to the ground, he spotted a hefty rock carefully mixed in with it.

hunks.baseline: “Uh-heh, uh-heh-heh-heh.”
hunks.sol: “Uh-heh. Uh-heh-heh-heh.”

hunks.baseline: Then the laugh cut off.
hunks.sol: Then his laughter abruptly stopped.

hunks.baseline: At the same time—
hunks.sol: At the same moment—

hunks.baseline: Sword Energy surged up, loaded with sixty years of internal energy.
hunks.sol: Sword Energy surged up, brimming with sixty years of internal energy.

hunks.baseline: Jin Taekyung watched and muttered,
hunks.sol: Watching him, Jin Taekyung muttered,

hunks.baseline: The words were barely out before the Head Elder charged like a lion. The dozen or so sheep screamed and scattered.
hunks.sol: Before the words had even left his mouth, the Head Elder charged like a lion. The dozen or so sheep scattered with shrieks.

hunks.baseline: “Throw dirt too!”
hunks.sol: “Keep throwing dirt!”

hunks.baseline: Even while they ran, they did not forget to throw dirt.
hunks.sol: Even while fleeing, they did not forget to throw dirt.

hunks.baseline: A fierce gale tore from the tip of the Head Elder’s sword. Sand, dirt, stones—whatever it was, it made no difference. In the face of that much power, it only shattered and scattered.
hunks.sol: A fierce gale tore from the tip of the Head Elder’s sword. Sand, dirt, stones—it made no difference. Before such overwhelming power, they could only shatter and scatter.

hunks.baseline: *How are we supposed to fight this guy?*
hunks.sol: *How the hell are we supposed to fight this guy?*

hunks.baseline: A head-on fight?
hunks.sol: Head-on?

hunks.baseline: Calling us melee damage dealers was putting it nicely. Leave the reconnaissance squad on the Head Elder and they’d be dying in piles before I could blink.
hunks.sol: Calling us melee damage dealers was putting it nicely. If I sent the reconnaissance squad against the Head Elder, they’d be dying in piles before I could blink.

hunks.baseline: I’d gotten attached to the bastards, though. I couldn’t let them die a pointless dog’s death.
hunks.sol: I’d gotten attached to the bastards, though. I couldn’t let them die meaningless dog’s deaths.

hunks.baseline: That one deserved to die, sure.
hunks.sol: That bastard deserved to die, sure.

hunks.baseline: *So why mix in rocks? The rocks.*
hunks.sol: *Why the hell did you have to mix in rocks?*

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder’s first target was Hyuk Mujin. Naturally. He’d thrown the first punch without a shred of fear.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder’s first target was Hyuk Mujin. Naturally. He had boldly struck the opening blow.

hunks.baseline: I let out a long breath and threw myself toward him.
hunks.sol: I heaved a deep sigh and hurled myself toward him.

hunks.baseline: I drove my spear at the Head Elder’s chest with everything I had.
hunks.sol: I drove my spear toward the Head Elder’s chest with everything I had.

hunks.baseline: At the same time, the Sword Energy about to cut through Hyuk Mujin’s back changed direction.
hunks.sol: At the same instant, the Sword Energy about to carve through Hyuk Mujin’s back changed direction.

hunks.baseline: No time to check the spearhead, sliced off clean. I snatched terrified Hyuk by the scruff of the neck.
hunks.sol: There was no time to check the spearhead that had been sliced clean off. I snatched the terrified Hyuk Mujin by the scruff of his neck.

hunks.baseline: But the Head Elder was not the type to let go.
hunks.sol: But the Head Elder was not about to give up that easily.

hunks.baseline: A tearing whistle through the air, and my side went hot. Even a graze ripped out a handful of flesh and sent blood spraying.
hunks.sol: The air shrieked, and my side went hot. The attack had only grazed me, yet it tore away a handful of flesh and sent blood spraying.

hunks.baseline: It hurt like hell. In this situation, though, even a scream was a luxury.
hunks.sol: It hurt like hell. In this situation, though, even screaming was a luxury.

hunks.baseline: I shoved Hyuk aside and turned. The Head Elder raised an eyebrow at that.
hunks.sol: I shoved Hyuk Mujin aside and turned around. The Head Elder raised an eyebrow.

hunks.baseline: Only one word, but the meaning came through perfectly. *The likes of you, stopping me?* That was the idea.
hunks.sol: One word, but the meaning came through perfectly.
*You think the likes of you can stop me?*

hunks.baseline: I answered like I was calm.
hunks.sol: I pretended to be calm.

hunks.baseline: “Don’t you value your life?”
hunks.sol: “Do you not value your life?”

hunks.baseline: “Heh heh. Look at this one. Young as you are, you’ve got quite a mouth.”
hunks.sol: “Heh heh. What a mouth on one so young.”

hunks.baseline: “Gramps, does your pepper still stand?”
hunks.sol: “Gramps, can you still get it up?”

hunks.baseline: It stood ramrod straight.
hunks.sol: It rose ramrod straight.

hunks.baseline: “…You’re still going strong.”
hunks.sol: “…Still going strong, I see.”

hunks.baseline: My grip on the spear went slick with sweat.
hunks.sol: My grip on the spear grew slick with sweat.

hunks.baseline: *I’m going to have to shake out every last reserve I’ve got to survive this.*
hunks.sol: *Looks like I’ll have to pull out every last trick I’ve got if I want to survive this.*

hunks.baseline: I had a lot more secrets than the Head Elder knew.
hunks.sol: I had far more secrets than the Head Elder knew.

hunks.baseline: A Skill that dumped several times my strength into a single blow—One Flash.
hunks.sol: A Skill that poured several times my strength into a single blow—One Annihilation.

hunks.baseline: *I never showed them, just in case something like this happened.*
hunks.sol: *I’ve never shown it to anyone, precisely for a situation like this.*

hunks.baseline: Was this what they called a last-resort technique in Murim?
hunks.sol: Was this what Murim called a final trump card?

hunks.baseline: One thing was certain: neither the Head Elder nor anyone else in Murim would see it coming.
hunks.sol: One thing was certain. Neither the Head Elder nor anyone else in Murim would see it coming.

hunks.baseline: “Encircling formation. Form up.”
hunks.sol: “Encircling formation. Spread out.”

hunks.baseline: Hyuk Mujin and the reconnaissance squad began closing in from every side.
hunks.sol: Hyuk Mujin and the reconnaissance squad began closing in from every direction.

hunks.baseline: A flimsy net for a fish as big as the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: It was a flimsy net for a fish as big as the Head Elder. But with a sharp enough harpoon, we had a chance.

hunks.baseline: But with a sharp harpoon, it was a fight we could try.
“To catch one old man? This is plenty.”
hunks.sol: “To catch one old man? More than enough.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder smiled like he was entertained.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder smiled, amused.

hunks.baseline: “What a fearless brat. The kind who only comes to his senses after a beating.”
hunks.sol: “What a fearless child. You need a beating to knock some sense into you.”

hunks.baseline: But that wish of his did not come true. A voice cut in out of nowhere.
hunks.sol: But he never got the chance. A voice suddenly cut in.

hunks.baseline: “I think I heard you wrong. Say that again.”
hunks.sol: “I must have misheard you. Say that again.”

hunks.baseline: A mountain of a man with fierce, piercing eyes. The voice from between his thick lips was cold as ice.
hunks.sol: A mountain of a man stood there, his eyes fierce beneath thick brows. The voice emerging from between his heavy lips was cold as ice.

hunks.baseline: “You were going to lay a hand on our boy?”
hunks.sol: “You said you were going to lay a hand on our boy?”

hunks.baseline: Sword Energy climbed his blade like wildfire and pointed at the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: Sword Energy blazed along his blade like wildfire and pointed at the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung, appearing like a savior, winked at me.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung had appeared like a savior. He winked at me.

hunks.baseline: The first time I had seen that face in a month.
hunks.sol: A face I had not seen in a month.

hunks.baseline: The moment Jin Wikyung appeared, the tension in my body melted away.
hunks.sol: The moment Jin Wikyung appeared, all the tension in my body melted away.

hunks.baseline: Wikyung was covered in blood, like he’d just come through a brutal fight. Large and small wounds showed through the tears in his clothes.
hunks.sol: Wikyung was covered in blood, as though he had fought a brutal battle to get here. Wounds large and small showed through the tears in his clothes.

hunks.baseline: But that was enough. The fact that he was alive was what mattered.
hunks.sol: But that was enough. What mattered was that he was alive.

hunks.baseline: *I have a lot I want to say, but it can wait.*
hunks.sol: *There’s a lot I want to say, but it can wait.*

hunks.baseline: A reunion after this war ended would not be too late. Wikyung seemed to think the same. He looked forward.
hunks.sol: We could have our reunion after the war was over. Wikyung seemed to feel the same way. He turned his gaze forward.

hunks.baseline: Where we were looking, the Head Elder slowly spoke.
hunks.sol: At the end of our gazes, the Head Elder slowly spoke.

hunks.baseline: “The fact that you made it this far means…”
hunks.sol: “If you have made it this far…”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s chilly voice cut him off.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s icy voice cut him off.

hunks.baseline: Good news. If Wikyung put it that way, the Elders had been no small part of this war—and the Head Elder’s hands and feet had just been cut off.
hunks.sol: Good news. If Wikyung put it that way, the Elders must have played a major role in this war—which meant the Head Elder had just lost his hands and feet.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder nodded readily.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder nodded without protest.

hunks.baseline: “They were always saying they wanted to die fighting like martial artists. They got their wish, so that’s fortunate.”
hunks.sol: “They were always saying they wanted to die fighting like martial artists. They got their wish, so that is fortunate.”

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder pointed his sword at us. Even with dozens of people in front of him, including me and Jin Wikyung, he stood there utterly composed.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder pointed his sword at us. Even with dozens of people facing him, including Jin Wikyung and me, he stood utterly composed.

hunks.baseline: “Now, let’s see who the victor is.”
hunks.sol: “Now, let us decide who the victor will be.”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung looked like he had something to say. His mouth opened, then shut tight.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung opened his mouth as if he had something to say, then pressed his lips firmly together.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of weapons drawn at once, all aimed at a single man. It was quite a spectacle.
hunks.sol: Dozens of weapons were drawn at once, all aimed at a single man. It was a magnificent sight.

hunks.baseline: “Yes, sir!”
hunks.sol: “We obey!”

hunks.baseline: With a huge shout, dozens of martial artists charged as one mass. I was no exception. My grip tightened on the spear, and my chest felt ready to burst.
hunks.sol: With a tremendous shout, dozens of martial artists charged as one. I was no exception. My grip tightened around my spear, and my chest felt ready to burst.

hunks.baseline: *We can win. No. We win, no matter what.*
hunks.sol: *We can win. No—we win, no matter what.*

hunks.baseline: A full-on brawl with no formation to speak of. But we had Jin Wikyung, a Peak master, and dozens of martial artists following him.
hunks.sol: It was an all-out clash with no formation to speak of. But we had Jin Wikyung, a Peak master, and dozens of martial artists following him.

hunks.baseline: *And there’s me.*
hunks.sol: *And we have me.*

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder had trusted his own strength too much. He had thrown every man into the front line without leaving even a minimal escort, and now the black-clad men were pinned down by the combined assault of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and the Mount Heng Sword Sect.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder had placed too much faith in his own strength. He had committed every last subordinate to the front lines without keeping even a minimal escort, and as a result, the black-clad men were now pinned down by the combined assault of the Jin Family of Taiyuan and the Mount Heng Sword Sect.

hunks.baseline: dies right here.
hunks.sol: would die right here.

hunks.baseline: It did not take long for that certainty to shatter to pieces.
hunks.sol: It did not take long for that certainty to shatter.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of tiny points shot out of nowhere. They cut through the air faster and harder than anyone had expected.
hunks.sol: Dozens of tiny specks shot out of nowhere. They tore through the air faster and harder than anyone had expected.

hunks.baseline: “Finger-Flicking Technique!”
hunks.sol: “It’s the Finger-Flicking Technique!”

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung’s shout. I was not given time to think about what that even was.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung’s shout did not leave me any time to wonder what that was.

hunks.baseline: Some went down. Others knocked the shots aside. The ones who fell did not get up again.
hunks.sol: Some people fell. Others knocked the projectiles aside. Those who fell never rose again.

hunks.baseline: It had lasted only an instant, but I saw it clearly. Tiny points packed into the area around their hearts and across their faces like buckshot.
hunks.sol: It lasted only an instant, but I saw it clearly. Tiny fragments embedded like buckshot around their hearts and across their faces.

hunks.baseline: They were closer to fragments now, but they had definitely been stones. Stones that could not take the Head Elder’s internal energy had shattered as they were fired at us.
hunks.sol: They were closer to shards now, but they had definitely been stones. Unable to withstand the Head Elder’s internal energy, they had shattered the instant he fired them at us.

hunks.baseline: *Is this possible?*
hunks.sol: *That’s possible?*

hunks.baseline: I got goose bumps, but it was not over.
hunks.sol: Goose bumps rose across my skin, but it was not over.

hunks.baseline: The Head Elder was stretching a hand this way.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder was reaching toward us.

hunks.baseline: This time Wikyung and I shouted together. The martial artists, already wound tight, scattered in an instant.
hunks.sol: This time, Wikyung and I shouted together. The martial artists, already wound tight, scattered in an instant.

hunks.baseline: *Good. We weren’t late this ti—*
hunks.sol: *Good. We weren’t too late this ti—*

hunks.baseline: The relief lasted only a moment.
hunks.sol: My relief lasted only a moment.

hunks.baseline: What shot at us this time was not the Finger-Flicking Technique. It was the Head Elder. He drove in among the martial artists and went berserk like a wild beast.
hunks.sol: What shot toward us this time was not the Finger-Flicking Technique.

hunks.sol: It was the Head Elder.
He plunged among the martial artists and rampaged like a wild beast.

hunks.baseline: Every time a sword flashed through the dark, another life went out. Wherever the Head Elder tore through, only stifled screams and corpses were left.
hunks.sol: Each time his sword flashed through the darkness, another life vanished. Wherever the Head Elder passed, he left only stifled screams and corpses behind.

hunks.baseline: Jin Wikyung charged in a fury. By then the Head Elder had already finished five people. And still not a drop of blood on that white face, enough to make you think of a ghost.
hunks.sol: Jin Wikyung charged at him in a fury. By then, the Head Elder had already killed five people. Yet not a single drop of blood stained his pale face, making him look like a ghost.

hunks.baseline: “You’re all clumsy. Peace must have lasted too long.”
hunks.sol: “You’re all so clumsy. Peace must have lasted too long.”
There was one fact none of us could deny.

hunks.baseline: There was one fact you could not deny. The Head Elder was a hero of the Great Faction War.
hunks.sol: The Head Elder was a hero of the Great Faction War.

hunks.baseline: He was stronger and more seasoned than anyone here. A Peak martial artist finished in countless real fights.
hunks.sol: He was stronger and more experienced than anyone present—a Peak martial artist honed through countless battles.

hunks.baseline: The Sword Energy Jin Wikyung drew out stabbed through empty air. The Head Elder slipped it with nothing more than a slight tilt of his head, then flicked a finger.
hunks.sol: The Sword Energy Jin Wikyung unleashed stabbed through empty air. The Head Elder avoided it with nothing more than a slight tilt of his head, then flicked a finger.

hunks.baseline: The target was me.
hunks.sol: His target was me.

hunks.baseline: I could not see a thing. Instinct knew anyway.
hunks.sol: I could not see anything. But instinct told me what it was.

hunks.baseline: *Internal energy.*
hunks.sol: *Qi.*

I threw myself into a roll without hesitation.

hunks.sol: I should have blocked it with my spear, but the attack was too unfamiliar for me to think that far ahead.
An ally whose name I did not know paid the price.

hunks.baseline: I felt rotten.
hunks.sol: I felt sick.

hunks.baseline: “Naryeotagon? What a donkey of a man.”[^1]
hunks.sol: “A Lazy Donkey Roll? You really are an ass.”

hunks.baseline: I spat out the dirt that had gotten in my mouth.
hunks.sol: I spat out the dirt in my mouth.

hunks.baseline: “If you want to live, what won’t you do?”
hunks.sol: “When you’re trying to live, there’s nothing you won’t do.”

hunks.baseline: “Haha. You’ve already become a proper man of Murim.”
hunks.sol: “Haha! You’ve already become a true man of Murim.”
What kind of monster was this bastard?

hunks.baseline: Had anyone ever seen a monster like that. Even while talking, he knocked aside every last bit of Jin Wikyung’s Sword Energy. I was speechless.
hunks.sol: Even as he spoke, the Head Elder knocked aside every last one of Jin Wikyung’s attacks.

hunks.baseline: The fight had barely started. Not even the time to drink a cup of tea had passed, and already nearly twenty martial artists had turned into cold corpses.
hunks.sol: The battle had barely begun. Not even enough time had passed to drink a cup of tea, yet nearly twenty martial artists had already become cold corpses.

hunks.baseline: A young man with a baby face that might have been twenty had his chest caved in and dropped to his knees.
hunks.sol: A baby-faced young man who could not have been much older than twenty dropped to his knees, his chest caved in.
They were not NPCs.

hunks.baseline: Not NPCs. Real people.
hunks.sol: They were real people.

hunks.baseline: Faces I had run into at least once at the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Faces I had shaken hands with. I gritted my teeth at that.
hunks.sol: Faces I had passed at least once in the Jin Family of Taiyuan. Faces belonging to people whose hands I had shaken.
I gritted my teeth.

hunks.baseline: I was not apologizing because I lacked the power to stop it. I was apologizing because I had used their deaths.
hunks.sol: I was not apologizing because I lacked the strength to save them.
I was apologizing because I had used their deaths.

hunks.baseline: Another person dropped to the Head Elder’s Finger-Flicking Technique like a puppet with its strings cut. But the corpse that looked about to topple backward popped up like a roly-poly toy. Then it pitched toward the Head Elder.
hunks.sol: Another man fell to the Head Elder’s Finger-Flicking Technique like a puppet with its strings cut. But just as the corpse seemed about to topple backward, it sprang upright like a roly-poly toy.
Then it pitched toward the Head Elder.

hunks.baseline: With one hand, the Head Elder took Jin Wikyung’s sword. With the other, he sent a palm strike at the corpse.
hunks.sol: With one hand, the Head Elder blocked Jin Wikyung’s sword. With the other, he launched a palm strike at the corpse.

hunks.baseline: I had hidden behind the corpse as it sailed through the air. I thrust my spear.
hunks.sol: Hidden behind the corpse as it flew through the air, I thrust out my spear.

hunks.baseline: “One Flash.”
hunks.sol: “One Annihilation.”

hunks.baseline: There was a roar that stuffed the ears.
hunks.sol: A deafening roar erupted.
